description: Replace the selected scene picture with a picture key already used in this version, not a library asset ID. Read get_project_context first. Saves a new version at once (restore_version undoes it); a change it cannot make is refused and nothing changes. Uses the direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

asset_id.description: A picture key this version already uses (a scene's picture from get_project_context), not a library asset id.

base_version.description: From get_project_context; the live version when left out.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A hook, Short or shape from check_video; the main video when left out.

name: swap_scene_picture

outputSchema.description: Clypmint swap_scene_picture result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Swap a scene picture
